content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how many users can log in to the [product_name] web server at the same time? I have installed the [product_name] behind a VPN module at a customer's site, and overall it works well. I can access the [product_name] through the web server, but occasionally, I suspect when someone else is logged in, I can't get access myself. Any insights would be appreciated! Thanks! [user_name]

Hi! The manual, specifically note 8 on the referenced page, doesn't give an exact number. It says multiple users can connect, but the limit depends on the CPU's memory usage. Hope this clarifies things!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to determine how many people can connect to the [product_name] web server at once. There's uncertainty in the documentation as it only mentions that the limit depends on system memory, without stating a specific maximum. This can cause confusion and usability challenges when multiple users attempt connection and some are blocked without a clear reason.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking clear, specific information about how many simultaneous web server logins are supported for [product_name]. They would also like more transparent communication when access is denied due to user limits.
